column3: New reference view "chase_cam": the gameplay camera behind the PLAYER'S OWN CAR driving a downtown avenue at 16:00 clear (DriveCam, ~40 km/h, traffic around; stage it like tools/driving_camera/drive_strip.gd). This is what the player sees most while driving: car paint and glass, road surface, traffic, the street ahead. Add the camera row (with any staging keys refcams needs; extend refcams_shot.gd minimally if a car must be staged) to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, then judge and fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "hero_foot": the default on-foot third-person camera behind the hero walking a midtown shopping pavement at 13:30 clear, rifle held, people within 3-12 m. What the player sees 90% of the time on foot: the hero's back and tracksuit, the crowd near, shop fronts, the pavement. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json (staging the player like still_shot's player view), judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "crowd_plaza": eye level (1.7 m) in the busiest downtown pedestrian spot you can find (a plaza or Broadway) at 12:30, a dense crowd 2-25 m away. Judge the crowd as a 2026 AAA crowd: variety, clothing, faces at 3 m, motion, grounding, LOD pops, repeated people. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "suburb_morning": a suburban residential street at 09:30 clear, eye level on the pavement: houses, lawns, driveways, street trees, parked cars, kerbs, power lines, a jogger or dog walker. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge against a 2026 AAA open world, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "night_aerial": downtown and the basin from ~350 m at 22:30 clear (the night flight look at a wider frame: towers, streets, freeway light rivers, the far grid, the sky). Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things. Coordinate with nothing: night-flight and night-lamps are merged, you own the result now.

New reference view "rain_day": a midtown boulevard at 14:00 in RAIN (overcast daylight, not night): wet road, wet facades, umbrellas, tyre spray, the sky. Daylight rain is far less tuned than night rain. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "marine_morning": the beach town at 08:00 under the MARINE layer (June gloom), eye level on a street toward the ocean: grey diffuse light, deck overhead, haze, palms, wet-ish surfaces. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "canyon_road": on a front-range switchback road at 1.7 m, 17:40 clear, looking out over the basin past a hill home or two: road asphalt and banks, chaparral and rocks near, the city and smog far. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "port_crane": the container terminal from ~45 m up at 16:30 clear: stacks, STS cranes working, straddle carriers, the ship, the water. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "airport_apron": the airport apron and concourse from ~25 m at 12:00 clear: parked liveried jets, jet bridges, ground vehicles, a taxiing jet, the terminal roof. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "la_river": in the LA River channel near the 6th St ribbon bridge at 15:30 clear (low, near the water), the concrete banks, bridges, the Arts District beyond. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "alley_night": a downtown service alley at 23:00 clear, eye level: dumpsters, fire escapes, bulkhead lamps, wet patches, steam, tags. Add the row to tools/refcams/cameras_w5.json, judge, fix the worst 3-5 things.

New reference view "mayhem": a staged combat moment on a midtown street at 18:00: a car exploding mid-blast near the hero (fx timing held), police cruisers with lights, panicking crowd, debris, smoke. Use the existing staging (fx_shot / AFTERMATH / STARS / POLICE keys of still_shot.gd); add whatever refcams_shot.gd needs minimally. Judge as a 2026 AAA action shot (fire, smoke lighting, debris, crowd reaction, police), fix the worst 3-5 things.

Shadows across the game: cascade split distances and fade, shadow acne / peter-panning, contact hardening, the shadow of every common kind (cars, trees, people, street props, buildings) at noon and golden hour, the visible cascade seams while driving, ambient occlusion where shadows fail. Fix what reads fake; measure GPU cost (tools/gpu_profile.gd small scenes). Prove on Forward+ small scenes (lavapipe) and opengl3 stills.

Shimmer and crawl in motion: thin geometry (wires, railings, fences, chain-link, window mullions, grilles, foliage edges, road paint edges) and high-frequency specular (car paint, wet road, water glints) flicker and stair-step at 1080p. Find the worst offenders with short frame strips of a slow camera move (still_shot SHOTS= with a moving EYE, or a strip tool), fix by geometric/specular AA (roughness from normal variance, pixel-footprint widening, alpha-to-coverage-like dithering), prove with strips before/after.

Visible popping while driving and flying: tier hand-offs (FULL/LOD/far city), batch LOD switches, shadow twins, crowd body swaps, prop draw distances, grass/shell fade, tree ladders. Record strips along a drive (tools/flight_bench.gd and drive_strip-style captures), list every pop the eye catches, fix the worst by dithered crossfades, matched far versions or moved ranges. Keep frame cost flat.

Generated buildings from 30-150 m at noon and golden hour across downtown, midtown and the historic core: what still reads as a box with a window grid (flat roof lines, repeated bays, identical neighbours, missing depth, uniform glass). Fix the worst 3-5 things in building.gdshader / Building / the kit, without moving any roll. Hold the far boxes (building_lod) in step.

Traffic variety: count which bodies and paints dominate a downtown street and the freeway (a census over a minute), then add 4-5 new Blender-built everyday bodies on the road-car loft (tools/make_road_cars.py / make_more_cars.py pattern: e.g. a compact wagon, a two-door sports car, a big luxury SUV, a small kei-style city van, an older 1970s sedan), appended to BodyType and rolled through ROLL_MAP rows exactly like Cars3 (no existing roll may move). Real exterior detail, far twin, cabin glass, dims.

The sky through a day from the street and from 300 m: the cumulus volume's shape and light at 09:00, 12:00, 15:00, 18:00, overcast and broken skies, cloud shadows on the ground (do they exist? add moving cloud shadows on Forward+ if not, cheap), the horizon haze meeting the far ranges. Fix the worst 3-5 things. tools/sky/sky_shot.gd for fast stills.

The camera itself: bloom / glare threshold and spread, exposure adaptation speed and range (walking from a sunlit street into an underpass / alley / tunnel and back), lens flare toward the sun (subtle, physically plausible, none on the web if it costs), chromatic fringe and grain levels, the vignette. Make it read like a 2026 game's photographic camera. CameraPost, vignette shader, Environment. Prove on Forward+ small scenes.

Every lit window at night and every shop window by day reads as a painted plane from up close? Walk the street at 2-6 m from storefronts and apartment windows at 13:00 and 21:00: the traced rooms' parallax, light leaking onto the pavement, reflections over them, people inside. Fix the worst 3-5 things (shop_interior / window_rooms / building.gdshader), keeping the far boxes in step.

The gate's still-open intermittent failures (docs/HANDOFF.md, the gate-flakes section "Still open"): traffic_ai tightest -4.35 m (lane groups sort by centre: order by front/rear extents), the on-ramp merge false, golden aerial gain 0.90, street_errands shop door, and the spawn block's chunk REPLACED while a file uses it (find the cause). Run shuffled SHARDS=3 gates (SMOKE_SHUFFLE=<seed>) and fix every failure at its cause until five consecutive clean runs. Coordinate: session traffic-order-fix may be fixing the first; merge origin/main often.

Frame cost after wave 4 (45 branches merged): measure the ten refcams with SPLIT=1 OSPLIT=1 against the numbers in docs/HANDOFF.md "Perf audit 4", find what grew, and cut the biggest costs (triangles, draws, shadow passes, CPU per physics tick, memory peak) without visible change (DIFF=1 pairs). Also the gate's peak RSS by part.

Forward+ review of wave 4's look work on small lavapipe scenes (CLAUDE.md "Forward+ review f" for the method): every wave-4 shader that does colour arithmetic, every additive quad, every new light. Find what the opengl3 stills hid (double-decoded colours, HDR-clipped additive pools, volumetric fog lit by brief lights) and fix it. tests/fwd_review_g_checks.gd.

The web build after wave 4: export, load every bookmark (tools/webshot/bookmarks.sh, one tab at a time), fix shader / WebGL / memory errors, check the pck size budget and the wasm heap, the sampler limit, uniform-block size. tests/web_build_checks.gd holds the rules; extend it for anything new.

Load time and the first minute after wave 4: LoadClock stages, the loading screen's shader warm-up and WarmRehearsal coverage of every system wave 4 added (first-use stutters: new particles, decals, shaders, bodies), the load cache. Measure with tools/load_time/ and tools/shader_warm/ and fix the biggest items.

OWNER PRIORITY: make the explosions EXTREMELY AAA (owner, 2026-11-01). Car blasts, rockets, gas/propane, chain reactions, at noon, golden hour and night, from 5 m and 60 m. Read the three earlier passes first (CLAUDE.md "What a blast leaves behind", "The blast, second pass" BlastFX, "The blast at arm's length" Blast3 / BlastVolume) and judge frame strips against a 2026 AAA game (the fireball's shape and roll, black-body colour through AgX, the shockwave and heat haze, smoke that is lit and lingers and rises into a mushroom, burning debris and sparks that bounce, scorch, glass, the light the blast throws on facades and the ground, camera shake and audio punch). Fix the worst things in order. Fluid-like motion (curl noise advection on the volume), self-shadowed smoke, secondary explosions, fuel fire pools. Forward+ AND the web fallbacks. rc2-mayhem judges a staged combat shot that includes a blast: YOU own blast_*.gd / BlastFX / Blast3 / the blast shaders; rc2-mayhem only stages and reports. Prove with fx strips (tools/glshot/fx_shot.gd FX_TIMES=, tools/explosions_2/blast_room_shot.gd) before/after, and on Forward+ small scenes under lavapipe.
